description: This PHP source file defines the LeadsViewList class, which extends ViewList, and is responsible for customizing the display of the Leads list view in the SuiteCRM application. It includes dependencies and customizes the preDisplay method to set up a custom HTML popup and initialize the list view.

classes.name: LeadsViewList
classes.description: A class extending ViewList to customize the Leads list view, including preparing HTML popups and list view setup.

methods.name: preDisplay
methods.description: Overrides the parent preDisplay method to include a custom popup HTML for Leads and initialize the LeadsListViewSmarty list view.
